plugins.name: fleet-status
plugins.description: Actionable AgentFleet updates and model proposals above the prompt.

plugins.name: lane-guard
plugins.description: Blocks fleet subagents from commits, pushes, deploys, migrations, destructive SQL, and working-tree reverts; starts a lane on another of its models while its own model is down; and warns a lane near its turn limit so it reports before it is cut off.

plugins.name: token-weather
plugins.description: A live forecast of the context window above the prompt (Anthropic sample, Apache-2.0).

plugins.name: brain
plugins.description: A /brain command: agent-brain token usage and the latest project memories.

plugins.name: fast-jev-compaction
plugins.description: Optional: verbatim compaction guided by TypeSafe Jev for the main conversation (needs a TypeSafe API key; sends conversation text to TypeSafe). By tamaratran, MIT.
